about: A character, item or scenery actor a client timeline made for itself: Name (DUM_TimelineTemplate_<template>), OriginalCharacterTemplate, SourceTemplateOverride, Speakers, VisualResourceId, PhysicsResourceId, ActiveDummy, TimelineType, VisibilityFlags. The figures and props of the main menu are such dummies: the menu is a level (SYS_Menuscreen_Act3_B or SYS_Menuscreen_Act1_A) with the timelines MM_Open_Boats, MM_Accept and MM_Accept_Temple playing in it, client only, with no server.

evidence.says: the component TLPreviewDummy, engine name from Ext.Debug.GetComponentTypes

in the Menu game state 98 entities carry it, each with Level.LevelName SYS_Menuscreen_Act3_B and TimelineActorData; four have ActiveDummy true and the templates of the four character actors of the timeline MM_Accept_Temple

questions.ask: which function creates the dummies of a timeline, and whether one can be asked for a template the timeline does not name (a figure of a mod's own in the main menu)
